g.text: GPU 2 cold-start C1: temperature, clocks and throttle reasons
A100 80GB PCIe · 1088 codes requests · 8 warmups · cu129 / R550 · observed host conditions
One-second samples; stage boundaries combine runner logs and reconstructed client timestamps. Shutdown includes client drain.
Temperature/flag coincidence does not identify the triggering sensor. GPU 1 had no HBM telemetry.
Different physical cards and starting thermal states: this is not a controlled causal performance comparison.
